numbering_note: MT-keyed except where marked; NON-IDENTITY book — MT 4:17 = WEB 5:1, MT 5:1-19 = WEB 5:2-20; use eccl_lib crosswalk

frame_seams.note: tier-1 frame spine; quotes are skeleton-tier here — writers re-collate pointed bytes via collate.py

divrei_verse_initial.count_object: verses whose first skeleton token is דברי

qohelet_sites.count_object: verses containing any token carrying the qohelet name — BOTH attested spellings (קהלת defective; קוהלת plene at the definite 12:8 form); sweep per attested spelling

amar_qohelet_formula.count_object: verses whose skeleton matches the said-qohelet formula (אמר/אמרה + optional article, either spelling) — the third-person frame intrusions

first_person_ani.count_object: verses containing the word-bound token אני or ואני (the monologue's pleonastic first person)

shavti_turns.count_object: verses containing token שבתי or ושבתי (the I-turned discourse pivot)

raiti_observations.count_object: verses containing token ראיתי or וראיתי (the I-saw observation frame)

amarti_speech.count_object: verses containing token אמרתי or ואמרתי (I-said self-address frame)

dibbarti_speech.count_object: verses containing token דברתי or ודברתי

melekh_sites.count_object: verses containing token מלך with article/prefix forms (המלך, למלך, ומלך) — noun/verb/name-object discipline applies before any count is cited

hevel_refrain.count_object_verses: verses containing any token whose skeleton contains הבל (het-bet-lamed חבל excluded — different consonant, different object)

havel_havalim_phrase.count_object: verses containing the contiguous skeleton phrase הבל הבלים; token-count counts phrase OCCURRENCES

hakol_hevel_phrase.count_object: verses containing the contiguous skeleton phrase הכל הבל

hevel_refrain.inclusio_note: the superlative havel-havalim phrase brackets the monologue: first and last sites form the 1:2 <-> 12:8 inclusio (12:8 with the plene definite qohelet form); byte-derived above, argued by writers from bytes

reut_ruach_phrase.count_object: verses containing the contiguous skeleton phrase רעות רוח

rayon_ruach_phrase.count_object: verses containing the contiguous skeleton phrase רעיון רוח — a DIFFERENT attested form, never blended with רעות רוח

ruach_any.count_object: verses containing any token carrying רוח (wind/breath/spirit — name the sense before counting)

tachat_hashemesh.count_object: verses containing the contiguous skeleton phrase תחת השמש

shemesh_outside_formula.count_object: verses with a שמש-carrying token but WITHOUT the תחת השמש phrase

time_catalogue.count_object: word-bound tokens עת with attested prefix forms (ועת/לעת/בעת); עתה (now) is a DIFFERENT token, never blended

zman_sites.count_object: verses containing token זמן (the rare season loan-register noun)

time_catalogue.samekh_bracket_note: SAMEKH segs stand at MT 3:1 and 3:8 — the catalogue's own seam verses (tier-3 weak, single witness; see pmarks)

tov_min_adjacent.count_object: verses with a טוב/טובה token immediately followed by a מ-prefixed token (skeleton adjacency HEURISTIC for the better-than construction — the Prov phrase-extension trap is LIVE: a מ-prefix after tov is not always comparative; construction check required before citing)

tov_openers.count_object: verses whose first skeleton token is טוב/טובה

web_better_verses.count_object: WEB verses containing the word better (ENGLISH-SIDE HEURISTIC texture, never evidence)

carpe_diem.count_object: verses containing both an אכל-family token and a שתה-family token (eat+drink co-occurrence — the enjoyment-refrain staging signal; writers argue each passage's bounds from bytes)

allegory_zone.zone_note: 11:7-12:8 (identity zone): the rejoice-then-remember bridge and the aging allegory; bounds are WRITER territory argued from bytes

ad_asher_lo_anaphora.count_object: verses containing the contiguous skeleton phrase עד אשר לא (the before-clause anaphora spine of 12:1-7)

zakhar_remember_in_zone.count_object: zone verses containing a זכר-root token

samach_rejoice_in_zone.count_object: zone verses containing a שמח-root token

youth_terms.count_object: verses containing youth-vocabulary tokens (בחור-family youth/prime, ילדות childhood, שחרות dawn-of-life)

elohim_bare_token.count_object: verses containing the exact unprefixed token אלהים

ha_elohim_token.count_object: verses containing the exact token האלהים (the definite the-God form Eccl favors)

elohim_any_form.count_object: verses containing ANY token carrying אלהים (bare, definite, prefixed)

yhwh_absence.count_object: verses containing any token carrying יהוה — swept, not assumed
yhwh_absence.note: ZERO byte-verified: the divine name never occurs in Eccl; every God-reference is Elohim. Any YHWH citation in an Eccl row is a fabrication. This absence is itself citable WITH this sweep digit.

catchword_adjacency.count_object: adjacent-MT-verse pairs sharing >=1 content token (skeleton tier, len>=2, stoplist-filtered) per chapter — HEURISTIC staging signal for the granularity gate; writers re-derive specific chains from bytes

web_but_texture.count_object: WEB verses containing ', but ' (or opening 'But ') per WEB chapter — ENGLISH-SIDE HEURISTIC, never evidence

parashah_distribution.count_object: PE/SAMEKH segs per MT chapter (WLC single witness; tier-3 weak in Writings)

kq_distribution.count_object: ketiv/qere variant notes (MT-keyed, with WEB back-ref where the offset zone is touched)

paseq_sites.count_object: paseq segs (COUNT-ONLY layer; MT-keyed with WEB back-ref where offset)

continuation_folds.count_object: WEB verses whose text folds across a paragraph mark (the M8-LOG-0002 folding class — LIVE in this prose book)
